reviews.title: A little disappointing
reviews.text: I have paid for the app and have access to the basic routines. Those are great. However, I have not been able to access the streaming videos, which is well over 75% of what is supposed to be available. I cannot find instructions to access and tried to send a message via the “Give Feedback” button which fails to send. I am not sure that I will renew when the time comes. I was looking forward to the extra options, but they are of no use to me if I still can’t access them.

reviews.title: It’s gone
reviews.text: I have used this app for over a decade. Woke one morning to my customized routines not only being gone, but the function is gone as well. All videos are not working. If the app is defunct, remove it! I miss my Simply Yoga…

reviews.title: No bug fixes
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for quite a while and decided to subscribe. Now for the past year it has been glitching badly. A routine starts and then goes silent. The girl doing the exercise doesn’t move. I reported once and they said they fixed it but nothing happened. I tried again today and the same thing. I don’t know what bugs and fixes they did because I see nothing different. In all the time I’ve had this app it’s never once updated. I emailed them May 4 and they responded on the 14th. $40 per month for this??! I don’t feel like they are doing anything to fix anything but they are gladly taking our money. I absolutely don’t recommend unless they can actually fix this.

reviews.title: Beginner yoga not for beginners!!
reviews.text: Wanted to get back into yoga after several years off and injury. The very first (beginner) lesson was not only way to fast (literally just saying pose after pose) but required literally bending in half and being able to put your head in between your knees. I honestly could cope with that if it were even a little bit slower so I could even think about, say, breathing? There are also no options to slow the video. Idk man anyone know any good apps? 😭

reviews.title: What happened to Simply Yoga?
reviews.text: The app I paid for has disappeared and now asks me for annual subscription.  After a vexing hour at 3 am, I tried signing up for the free trial and it doesn’t work!  Can’t even see if it possibly could be worth a subscription and can’t find where to complain about being stripped of my prior purchase.  Looking for a better yoga app.  Very disappointed.

reviews.title: Liked the old version
reviews.text: I liked the simplicity of the older version and the lack of emphasis on fees.  Just getting back into this and really just wanted something simple.  Yes, users can get to the free routines but they take more clicks.

reviews.title: Am I missing something?
reviews.text: I have tried both of the apps and they go through the routines WAY too fast. I’ve tried to slow them down but still can not find a way. I thought yoga was supposed to be relaxing. Rushing through the movements defeats the purpose. I find it annoying to pause it each time when I’m in the middle of a pose.

reviews.title: Best 4 beginner +
reviews.text: It’s been out forever, easy to understand good pace, easy for beginners older people people that need to start out at the very minimum level and you can increase from there. They have updated it and added much more value to the pro which I have is worth every penny simple easy effective visualbig fan always have been.

reviews.title: Greatest Home instructions
reviews.text: I love this app and have been using it for 10 years – and have told all my friends about it. The instructions are better than any yoga studio I’ve ever attended. My only complaint is the disruptive ads that come after Shavasena (sp?). After doing the whole routine and having a nice Shavasena for five minutes, a blaring obnoxious ad comes on and all the relaxing that you just did, has completely been obliterated. I can’t even relax during Shavasena because I know the ads will be coming on. I wish they would just stop the ads at the end of Shavasena, like they used to, or at least have an option to turn the ads off!!

reviews.title: I love this app
reviews.text:
I’ve had this app for many years.
 I was a beginner when I first started. 
 It’s very instructional (explanatory) and tells you when to breathe and specifically how to get into each of the moves and she does it with you. 
It’s like having your own personal yoga teacher. 
I always feel at peace afterwards. 
I definitely would recommend it for anyone. I like the old version better maybe cause I’m used to watching the girl they had before, but they both are great. 
I wouldn't change anything about it.

reviews.title: Not bad.
reviews.text: I like the simplicity of the background view. Simply a woman completing poses as dictated by a voiced-over female in detailed description. That is nice as it tells you what parts of your body should be doing in each pose. There is no background music which I like to have playing during yoga. I suppose I could play my own.

reviews.title: Like the simplicity so far.
reviews.text: I’ve only done 2 sessions so far and definitely considering buying the pro version. I am mainly comparing this app to YouTube videos. I like that the app is straight to the point and I don’t have to hear about a sponsor. I like the audio cues and that can hear a bit of another app in the background. Wish it wouldn’t turn down the other app so that I could listen to a book at the same time. I feel like the sun salutation flow is a bit too fast. UI a little outdated but I can live with that. It did the same workout as the first time so I would like if there was a little list of available workouts. I will make a custom one for variety but would like if there were a few options to jump in with.

reviews.title: Great programs
reviews.text: I love the app. I do the 30 minute and 20 minute yoga. Think they are great! My only complaint is the Sun salutation routine moves so quickly and is not so relaxing. Wish it was just 30 seconds longer.

reviews.title: Daily routine for the past four years
reviews.text:
I use it almost exclusively on my Apple TV, though sometimes I use it when not at home. Been using it religiously for the past four years. I can feel the blood flowing to the parts of my body that I know need it. I can definitely say that I’m a calmer driver because of it, and that has flowed into my everyday dealings with people.

One thing I wish I knew the answer to: what style of yoga is practiced here?

reviews.title: Very helpful for depression
reviews.text: I’ve just started doing yogo and it’s helped me out alot with my sadness/depression, it helped me get my mind off things if only for a moment!!! I really have a new respect for yoga..should of been doing it !!!!

reviews.title: Exactly what I was looking for.
reviews.text: I am a beginner and this is exactly what I was looking for. There are clear instructions for each pose including the proper breathing techniques. I also like the way you are able to choose the length of time you want. I enjoy the sound of the ocean in the background, especially while doing the corpse pose!

reviews.title: Loving it
reviews.text: I first started using Simply Yoga 10 years ago. Initially I just wanted it to help me get started on Yoga. I liked that the woman who was doing the poses wasn’t that super flexible 😎 Made me feel a lot better during my struggles to get the poses and flow right. Now 10 years later I still use the App 2-3 times per week. The “new” woman is slightly more flexible than the previous, but still makes even the harder poses look achievable.

reviews.title: Advertisement at end of yoga
reviews.text:
LOVE Simply Yoga! 
I’m not sure if it’s possible, but I would prefer a more peaceful advertisement after my relaxing yoga. The advertisement that came on today was very loud and stimulating just after the yoga instructor had advised me to relax. Lol

reviews.title: Perfect for me
reviews.text: This provides the poses I like most for balance and flexibility.  The 20 minute routine lets me find time to keep up my practice even on a busy day.  My only complaint is about the sometimes noisy ads that follow closely after the end of the routine.  Some ads continue the relaxing music, but others run loud discordant beats that shock you out of the mellow relaxing mood of the yoga routine .  I don’t mind having ads. I can’t afford the ad-free subscription.  I just wish you either delayed the noise or used more soothing music.

reviews.title: Renewed strength & flexibility!!!
reviews.text:
Excellent for beginners, experienced, and advanced. Awesome way to begin and finish your day. 

I have a bad spine and this has given me, renewed strength and flexibility!!! It is the healing that I have been searching for!

Buy the app one time, no additional charges, no monthly fees. 

No regrets, just extreme gratitude and physical peace!!!

reviews.title: Not as I imagined
reviews.text:
Hi, I was using Simply Yoga last year and loved the 20 minute version. The holidays came and I had no time to practice.

With the stay-at-home advisory during this Covid-19 pandemic, I decided to restart my Simply Yoga practice. While I appreciate the change in format, there is NO EASY FLOW of the 20 minute practice. She’s sitting, she’s standing...and the Sun Salutation is way too fast. I really like, within the 20 minute version, the new poses, however, no flow in getting to the next pose.
I do not want to upgrade to another version, I was totally happy with the older version. 
Just my 59 year old opinion.

reviews.title: Specific to the device
reviews.text:
I have downloaded this app and paid for the “Pro” version on my Fire Stick, however since there is no account information, I would have to pay for it again to have it on my phone.  Also, i have two different Fire Sticks, and the choices I make on one don’t transfer to the other. So I create a whole flow on the downstairs TV, but when i open it on the upstairs TV, I have to start from scratch. It’s a drag!!  
The instructions are good and the video is much improved, but I’m not paying for it twice.
